Diera

Biography

Diera is a sorceress close to Governor Valrasian. She supplies magic through Karansul and installed the traps guarding the governor’s collection. She repeatedly warns Zak away from the missing Princess. Grey Leaf’s account of the white-haired cloaked figure helps expose her involvement, and Lu-a-Jalla later identifies Diera as her captor, driven by jealousy over the governor. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
